essentials.name: First week essentials
essentials.about: The eight places you'll need in your first week, about half an hour on foot.

stops.say: Start at the library: study rooms, computers and printing, and Saxbys by the door. Bring your PantherCard.
The main student center. Food is downstairs, the Dean of Students and Orientation are upstairs.
The Rec: pools, a climbing wall and a gym. Students get in with their PantherCard.
Textbooks and GSU gear. The PantherCard office is next door in Student Center West.
The Panther Quad, campus's newest green space, built where Gilmer St used to run.
First-year advising is on floors 4 and 5 here, and Career Services is on the first floor.
Financial aid, billing and help with registration, all in one place since 2025.
A first-year residence hall, with a dining hall that stays open around the clock on weekdays.
